title: Heavy Load Checker target spec (v2)
description: One website/runtime to benchmark. Phase 2 campaigns reference N of these. Validated by heavyload.targetspec.validate().

site_id.description: Stable id used to group runs across repeats

language.description: e.g. python, node, typescript, go, java, kotlin, csharp, swift, rust, c, cpp, php, ruby

image.description: Legacy Docker-era field; tolerated but unused since v2

image_digest.description: Legacy Docker-era field; tolerated but unused since v2

build_cmd.description: Legacy metadata; the native build lives in native.build_cmd

start_cmd.description: Legacy metadata; the native start lives in native.start_cmd

expected_payload_sha.description: Ensures every language serves an identical response

cpuset_cpus.description: Legacy cpuset hint; the generator pins itself only

native.description: Native (non-Docker) process lifecycle. Parsed into argv and executed without a shell by scripts/native_target.py.

start_cmd.description: Command that starts the target server on host_port

working_dir.description: Directory the command runs in (default: the spec's folder)

build_cmd.description: Optional untimed build step run before start

ready_probe.description: Wait for health_path to answer before returning

adapter.description: Runtime-internals source. The app should expose this endpoint as JSON.
